adjudication.rationale: The diff explicitly introduces a `raw_html` cook method (Post.cook returns `raw` when `cook_method == Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]`) and uses it for imported embeds (TopicEmbed.import creates posts with `cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]`). In the update path for an existing embed, `TopicEmbed.import` calls `PostRevisor#revise!` with `absolutize_urls(url, contents)` and `skip_validations: true`, which will overwrite the post’s raw content whenever `content_sha1` changes, without any sanitization step shown in the diff. Since the embed view renders `raw post.cooked`, a malicious/compromised feed can repeatedly push new HTML/JS payloads into the stored post on each poll/update. This is a verifiable security defect introduced by the change.
